name: pg_list_tables
description: This tool allows you to list the tables visible to the connected PostgreSQL role, including their schema, estimated row count, and total on-disk size. Use this tool to orient yourself in an unfamiliar database before writing queries. System catalogs are excluded unless include_system is true. Row counts come from planner statistics and can be stale; run an explicit count query when exactness matters.

schema.description: Restrict the listing to a single schema, e.g. public.

pagination.title: Pagination options
pagination.description: Standard cursor-based pagination controls shared by every list endpoint in this server.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned in the previous page of results. Omit for the first page.

page_size.description: Number of items to return per page. The server clamps values above the maximum.
